page.overview:
Who is Minor Rare Hunters?

The following minor Rare Hunters appear in the Yu-Gi-Oh! anime.

This list includes Rare Hunters that do not have their own pages on this site. In the Japanese anime, the term "Rare Hunters" refers to a specific group of Ghouls. In the English anime, the entire Ghouls organisation are called Rare Hunters. This page is using terminology from the English anime.

Three Rare Hunters reported the announcement of Battle City to Marik Ishtar and informed him that it meant Duelists throughout Japan would all be gathering in Domino City. Marik replied that it was convenient that all of their prey was gathering in a single location and ordered them to gather Rare Hunters from all over the world.

In the Japanese ending credits, the one with dialogue is called Rare Hunter (レアハンター Reā Hantā) and voiced by Eiji Takemoto.
